role: The enchantment registry: the static table of every 1.7.10 enchantment (effect id, weight, type, min/max level, per-level enchantability windows) plus the hook methods its subclasses override.
scope_reason: The enchanting table and anvil are switched off (world.conf enchanting = off, anvil = off), but enchantments still enter the world through chest-loot enchanted books and the librarian's and priest's villager trades, so the registry itself is live on both sides.

members.name: statics: enchantmentsList, enchantmentsBookList and the 22 enchantment singletons
members.note: generated by the oracle's EnchantTable from the live objects; enchantmentsBookList is the same rows in id order, which trades.c walks as NENCHANTED_BOOKS

members.name: type
members.note: the type ordinal; canEnchantItem is ported in enchant.c:can_enchant_item

members.name: name
members.note: the generator stored getName()'s full key (enchantment.digging), not setName's short form

members.name: Enchantment
members.note: each row is one constructed enchantment

members.name: getWeight
members.note: looked up per effect id by pick_weighted

members.name: getMaxLevel
members.note: n/a: the base body (1): every enchantment class 1.7.10 registers overrides it (Protection, Oxygen, WaterWorker, Thorns, Damage, Knockback, FireAspect, LootBonus, Digging, Untouching, Durability, the four Arrow ones, FishingSpeed), so the ENCHANTS max_level column is theirs

members.name: getMinEnchantability
members.note: the per-level window stored as evaluated arrays, read by enchant.c:map_enchantment_data

members.name: getMaxEnchantability
members.note: n/a: the base body (min + 5): every registered enchantment class overrides it, as for getMaxLevel

members.name: calcModifierDamage
members.note: the base returns 0; the only override (EnchantmentProtection) is summed in csrc/engine/living.c:living_enchantment_modifier_damage, the EnchantmentHelper.getEnchantmentModifierDamage port

members.name: func_152376_a
members.note: the base returns 0.0F; the EnchantmentDamage override is not ported (see that record)

members.name: canApplyTogether
members.note: read from the CAN_APPLY_TOGETHER bitmask the generator produced by calling the game's own method on every pair

members.name: getName
members.note: runs only when a frame is drawn (the row replays draw none): covframes' frame coverage runs it in cf-idx-tipsword-s1 and cf-idx-tipbook-s1 (the tooltip's getTranslatedName)

members.name: getTranslatedName
members.note: StatCollector text plus roman numerals: client display only

members.name: canApply
members.note: n/a: its callers are CommandEnchant (no command in this game) and ContainerRepair (anvil = off); the table and the random enchanting go through type.canEnchantItem, which enchant.c:can_enchant_item ports

members.name: func_151368_a
members.note: empty base body; the EnchantmentDamage override is not ported

notes: The table is generated, not hand-written: oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/EnchantTable.java writes csrc/engine/enchants.h by reading the oracle's own objects.
